items.title: Loan Marketplace Launch Could Be A Big Test For nCino Stock (NCNO)
items.why: Lender software moving into loan marketplaces points to banks rebuilding origination channels that card and personal loan teams may eventually use.
items.summary_ai: nCino is preparing to launch a loan marketplace that analysts see as a major test for the company.
